recognition.summary: Validated and fixed product vulnerabilities may receive public credit if desired.

reporting.summary: The policy publishes direct product-security email reporting and requests PGP encryption.

rewards.summary: The policy explicitly excludes bug bounties and monetary compensation.

limitations: Never test products in clinical environments or while used by patients.
This is the product-security policy; non-product reports follow a separate route.
